text: What is the difference between intensional and extensional MLTT?
choices: Extensional MLTT adds a rule making propositional equality imply definitional equality, at the cost of undecidable type-checking
Intensional MLTT has no identity type
explanation: Extensional rule: if p : a = b then a ≡ b definitionally. This makes the theory simpler but type-checking undecidable.
